title: Codex Code Review Result
description: Provenance-preserving, bounded structured evidence contract for /codex:review. Passed to `codex exec --output-schema`. Ask for the 20 highest-impact actionable findings; use INCOMPLETE rather than silently truncating when more findings are known to exist. Exclude pure style preferences unless they violate a cited project rule.

status.description: FINDINGS requires >=1 finding. NO_FINDINGS requires zero findings and means only 'no actionable findings for this declared scope' — not that the code is correct or ready to ship. INCOMPLETE requires a non-empty limitation explaining what failed or was truncated.

scope.description: The exact reviewed scope (e.g. paths, diff range, or question) as declared to Codex — not a restatement of the whole repository.

findings.description: Sequential, unique IDs beginning at F-001 (no gaps, duplicates, or reordering). Empty when status is NO_FINDINGS.

id.description: Sequential unique identifier starting at F-001.

path.description: Repo-relative or absolute path to the affected file.

line.description: 1-based line number, or null when the finding is not line-scoped.

evidence.description: Concrete evidence for the claim (code, line ranges, reasoning) — not a restatement of the claim.

minimal_fix.description: The smallest concrete change that would resolve the finding.

limitations.description: Non-empty when status is INCOMPLETE, explaining what failed or was truncated. May also note review caveats for FINDINGS/NO_FINDINGS.
